title: 第17章 被罚站的菩提道人第18章 金灵圣母入朝歌
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第17章被罚站的菩提道人！“人皇，贫道是想问一问人皇，当初人皇下达人皇诏，发下‘普天之下，莫非皇土；率土之滨，莫非皇臣’之宏愿，还曾作数？”
察觉到帝辛对自己的态度并不友好，菩提直接开门见山地说到，
果然，
在菩提话落之后，帝辛脸上的冷漠没有丝毫变化，而是用冷清的目光轻瞟着他，
略带不悦道：“你还有三个呼吸的时间！”
“人皇！”
察觉到帝辛散漫和不屑的神色，菩提胡子都要气歪了。
自己好歹也是圣人斩掉的三尸之一，这时候屈尊降贵地来找人皇，非但没有受到重视，反而备受轻视。
泥人还有三分火气，菩提自然心生不悦，眼底深处忽然闪过一抹隐晦的杀机。
就在这时，
摆放在人皇殿的人皇玺和人皇剑，忽然震动了一下，朝歌上空更是出现一双只有大罗金仙才能看到的眼睛，
同时，
一道隐晦不可察的波动，瞬间蔓延到了大半个洪荒和四海——
唰！
东海深处，
一双充满杀戮和疯狂的血眼，忽然出现在东海海眼，隐隐间一条散发着混沌之色的庞大龙头，忽然在海眼之中一闪而逝。
紧接着，
一道充满无上霸气的声音，忽然在东海龙王的识海中炸响——
“有人要对人皇不利，你手持本祖龙珠，速去保护人皇！”
“是，老祖！”

东海龙王知道事情的严重性，二话不说拿起祖龙龙珠就冲出东海，直奔朝歌！
与此同时，
远在金鳌岛上的金灵圣母，忽然生出心惊肉跳的感觉，隐隐间察觉到哪里不对劲，掐指一算，脸色陡然大变——
“奇怪，闻仲命数的是‘逢绝必死’，怎么会在这时候遭遇死劫，而且还是在朝歌中，难道是那人皇要杀他？”
说到这里，金灵圣母眉头紧蹙，自言自语道：“听说前段时间，那人皇题诗亵渎女娲娘娘，非但没有悔意，还仗着自己的身份，对女娲娘娘动手，人皇失德，也不知道我那傻徒儿为何要保他！”
“罢了，我就去一趟朝歌，若真是那人皇敢对闻仲动手，我把他带回来了便是！”
金灵圣母说着就离开了金鳌岛，直奔朝歌而去！
……
而洪荒上的其他大能，却都只是看了一眼，就没有关注朝歌的事情了。
但这时，
刚刚对人皇动了杀机的菩提，在人皇剑和人皇玺震动时，就已经清醒了过来，
紧接着，
他又感觉到，朝歌上空忽然出现一双眼，正死死地盯着自己后，‘唰’地一下冒出了一身冷汗！
心中刚刚生出的那道杀意，也在一瞬间消失无踪！
刚刚那一瞬间，
他清晰地察觉到了死亡和毁灭的气息！
菩提相信，要是自己心中杀机在强上一丝，绝对会被人道之力、人皇玺和人皇剑斩杀当场！
“你想杀孤！”
而看到菩提脑门上方冷汗，帝辛脸上则浮现出一抹杀意，
下一刻，

朝歌之上人道之力震动，霎时间风起云涌、日月无光！
content_en:
Chapter 17: The Bodhi Taoist who was forced to stand! "Human Emperor, I just want to ask the Human Emperor. When the Human Emperor issued the Human Emperor's edict and issued the grand wish of 'could the whole world be the imperial land; and the shores of the land, could it be the imperial ministers', did you still think about it?"
Realizing that Di Xin's attitude towards him was not friendly, Bodhi said straight to the point,
Sure enough,
After Bodhi finished speaking, the indifference on Di Xin's face did not change at all, but he glanced at him with a cold look.
He said with a slight displeasure: "You still have three breaths!"
"Human Emperor!"
Sensing Di Xin's casual and disdainful expression, Bodhibeard was almost furious.
After all, he was one of the three corpses beheaded by the saint. At this time, he condescended to come to the Human Emperor. Instead of being taken seriously, he was despised.
The clay figurine was still angry, so Bodhi was naturally displeased, and a vague murderous intention suddenly flashed deep in his eyes.
Just then,
The Human Emperor's Seal and the Human Emperor Sword placed in the Human Emperor's Palace suddenly shook, and a pair of eyes that only Daluo Jinxian could see appeared above Chaoge.
At the same time,
An obscure and undetectable wave instantly spread to most of the wilderness and the four seas——
Uh-huh!
Deep in the East China Sea,
A pair of bloody eyes full of killing and madness suddenly appeared in the eye of the East China Sea. A faintly huge dragon head exuding the color of chaos suddenly flashed in the eye of the sea.
Immediately afterwards,
A voice full of supreme domineering power suddenly exploded in the sea of consciousness of the Dragon King of the East China Sea——
"Someone wants to do harm to the Human Emperor. Hold the Ancestral Dragon Ball and quickly protect the Human Emperor!"
"Yes, ancestor!"
The Dragon King of the East China Sea knew the seriousness of the matter. Without saying a word, he picked up the Ancestral Dragon Ball and rushed out of the East China Sea, heading straight for Chaoge!
At the same time,
The Holy Mother of Jin Ling, who was far away on Jin'ao Island, suddenly felt frightened. She vaguely sensed that something was wrong. After counting with her fingers, her face suddenly changed -
"It's strange. Wen Zhong's destiny is 'Death is inevitable'. How come he encountered death at this time, and it's still in Chaoge? Could it be that the Human Emperor wants to kill him?"
Speaking of this, the Holy Mother of Jinling frowned and said to herself: "I heard that some time ago, the Human Emperor wrote a poem to blaspheme the Nuwa Empress. Not only did he have no regrets, but he also relied on his identity to attack the Nuwa Empress. The Human Emperor was immoral. I don't know why my stupid disciple wanted to protect him!"
"That's all, I'll go to Chaoge. If that Human Emperor really dares to attack Wen Zhong, I'll bring him back!"
With that said, Our Lady of Jinling left Jin'ao Island and headed straight for Chaoge!
…
But the other great powers in the ancient world only glanced at it and paid no attention to Chaoge's affairs.
But at this time,
Bodhi, who had just launched a murderous intention against the Human Emperor, had already come to his senses when the Human Emperor's sword and the Human Emperor's Seal shook.
Immediately afterwards,
He felt again that a pair of eyes suddenly appeared in the sky above Chaoge, staring at him, and he suddenly broke out in a cold sweat!
The murderous intention that just emerged in my heart also disappeared in an instant!
At that moment,
He clearly sensed the breath of death and destruction!
Bodhi believed that if the murderous intention in his heart was even stronger, he would definitely be killed on the spot by the power of humanity, the Human Emperor's Seal and the Human Emperor's Sword!
"You want to kill Gu!"
Seeing the cold sweat on Bodhi's forehead, Di Xin showed a murderous intent on his face.
The next moment,
The power of humanity above Chaoge vibrated, and in an instant, the wind and clouds surged, and the sun and moon lost their light!
